record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: For a vector bundle or sheaf near a contractible subvariety Y of a variety X, what axioms should a general theory of local characteristic classes satisfy?

evidence.quote: Question 15. What should be the axioms for a general theory of local characteristic classes of vector bundles around a contractible subvariety?

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open foundational problem in a list of 25 open questions about vector bundles and their moduli. While local invariants such as the local holomorphic Euler characteristic have been studied (notably for contractible curves and rational surfaces, with applications to local charges of instantons), no general axiomatic theory of local characteristic classes around contractible subvarieties appears to have been established. No subsequent work resolving the axiomatic formulation was located.

status_evidence.title: Characteristic class - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Axiomatic frameworks exist for global Chern and Euler classes, but no analogous local theory around contractible subvarieties is documented.
status_evidence.claim: Standard axiomatic theories address only the global setting.
